subject: general
question: Who among the following founded the 'Servants of India Society'?
solution:
The correct answer is __Gopal Krishna Gokhle.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Gopal Krishna Gokhle formed the Servants of India Society on June 12, 1905, in Pune, Maharashtra.
 
• This society chooses to remain away from political activities and political organizations.
 
• Leaders and members of this society were mainly prominent Indians.
 
• Many campaigns to promote sanitation, health care, education, and fight the discrimination, poverty, oppression of women and domestic abuse were organized by Servants of India Society.
